name: ResonantOS/2.0.0-alpha
canonical_upstream: Self (org repo, dev branch). Evidence: org-owned, 1056 commits, 12 contributors, 3593 CI runs; tompennington/2.0.0-alpha (75 commits, stale since 2026-06) and 15 forks are older or derived copies. apps/augmentor inside is a subtree import (2026-09-14) of Manolo Remiddi's original Augmentor repo and is diverging from upstream (see R10).
purpose: Current ResonantOS runtime: Chrome Manifest V3 side-panel/new-tab extension plus authenticated local Node.js bridge (loopback, capability tokens); Provider Fabric, Agent Control, Living Archive memory, add-on SDK, Hermes/OpenCode delegation, vendored Augmentor.
technologies: JavaScript/TypeScript (React 19, Vite, vitest), Node >=24.21 ESM bridge, Chrome MV3 extension, TS/JS inside apps/augmentor (DeepSeek Harness plugin)
primary_branch_or_version: branch dev (default); package.json resonantos-vnext 2.0.0-beta.1; extension manifest 0.1.14; no GitHub releases; 1 tag archive/pr-198-blackboard-experiment; 97 branches
last_material_update: 2026-10-18 (merge of PR #534 feat/dsh-native-auth; src, browser-first and docs all changed Aug-Oct 2026)
licenses: MIT: LICENSE.txt ('Copyright (c) 2026 ResonantOS contributors'), package.json MIT, GitHub detects MIT, README says MIT. Sub-components: apps/augmentor LICENSE plain MIT (Copyright Manolo Remiddi); packages/addon-sdk MIT.
maintenance_signal: Commits: 585 in last 90d, 1056 in last 365d (repo created 2026-06-05, history imported from May 2026). 12 contributors (tompennington 651, ManoloRemiddi 289, simongonzalezdc 43). Issues 64 open/198 closed; PRs 5 open/267 closed. CI on dev reported by CI: project-issue-sync, security-drift, security-observe, alpha-build, agent-control-live-certification all success 2026-10-18/19. The 'verify' workflow is registered at GitHub but has no file at dev HEAD or anywhere in git history; its last runs were on a PR branch 2026-09-01 (mixed success/failure/cancelled).
test_evidence: 288 test files (vitest and node:test) in src/, browser-first/test, examples/, scripts/, apps/augmentor/test, addons/*/test; npm scripts test, verify:alpha, test:browser-first, test:security-pipeline. CI results are reported by CI, not executed by us. docs/reference/CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md itself states 'Implemented' means code plus deterministic test, not live acceptance; live-proof columns mostly open.
relation_to_vision: Current runtime (alpha/beta.1). Only read-only wallet/DAO helpers; wallet signing and DAO actions are human-only. Contains no DAO program code.
flags: name/version mismatch (repo '2.0.0-alpha', package 2.0.0-beta.1, docs/release says 2.0.0-alpha.0); legacy src/ React shell and legacy ADRs (ADR-009, ADR-035 Rust/Electron host) partly not applicable; dangling references to ADR-055/056 and docs/addons/resonant-extension-framework (absent); two bridge launchers (root run-bridge-minimal.mjs shim differs from browser-first/host/run-bridge-minimal.mjs, plus run-browser-first.mjs); 3+ memory implementations (src/core/memory-provider.ts, browser-first/host/memory-*.mjs, examples/living-archive-memory-service.mjs and reference-memory-service.mjs); duplicated SDK (src/sdk/addons shims vs packages/addon-sdk); no Rust source despite ADR references
